entities.summary: Onuora Nzekwu also known as Joseph Onuora Nzekwu was a Nigerian professor, writer and editor from the Igbo people. He is author of the 1961 novel Wand of Noble Wood and the 1963 novel Eze Goes to School, which was among the African Writers Series.
